name: Read AI
description: Read AI lets agents search and read the meeting reports, summaries, transcripts, and action items of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Read AI account through the browser.

prompts.text: What action items were assigned to me this week?
What did we decide about the launch date in the last product sync?

apps.name: Read AI
apps.description: Meeting reports, transcripts, and action items, over Read AI's MCP server with browser sign-in.
